entities.name: RibBA
observations: 400-aa sequence aligns to reviewed bacterial RibBA proteins at 56.4–59.7% identity with 98.8–99.2% query coverage; evidence supports a bifunctional riboflavin-biosynthesis enzyme.

Reviewed RibBA homolog annotations include GTP cyclohydrolase II (EC 3.5.4.25) and 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone-4-phosphate synthase (EC 4.1.99.12) activities; exact activity remains homology-inferred for this query.
Reference annotations report Mg2+ or Mn2+ and Zn2+ binding; these cofactor assignments are homolog-based, not direct measurements of the query.
Sequence-derived: 400 aa, estimated mass 44,778 Da, pI 5.21; these are computational estimates.

entities.name: Riboflavin biosynthesis
observations: Reviewed RibBA homologs are annotated in riboflavin biosynthesis, contributing DHBP and pyrimidine precursor-forming reactions.
